newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore stock market closed Thursday for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Singapore stock market closed Thursday for holiday.

text.p: No trading took place on the Stock Exchange of Singapore (SES) on Thursday with the market closed for the Labour Day public holiday.
The key Straits Times Industrials Index had closed stronger on Wednesday rising 14.06 points to 2,004.26, led by blue chips rebounding from recent sharp falls, dealers said.
Total market volume was a moderate 109 million shares producing 262 gainers and 71 losers.
Trading on the SES resumes on Friday.
